name: B10-0264/2026 (ECR) – The cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns acid attacks on two Indonesian activists, Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi, and on other defenders. It asks Indonesia to move the Yunus case from a military court to a civilian court, to investigate both attacks fully and independently, and to look into police violence at the August 2025 protests. It also asks the European Union's foreign policy chief, the European Commission and European Union member states to raise these issues with Indonesia and to consider sanctions on officials responsible for human rights violations.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its opinion and asks Indonesia to act.
- The requests target Indonesia's government, courts and security forces, and European Union diplomats.
- Next, Parliament sends the text to European Union institutions and to Indonesia's government and parliament.
